notes.title: BOOM! Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story DLC is here!
notes.content:
Get ready to experience some of Riot Games’ most iconic tracks! Below is what you can expect to see in the new DLC.

The three BOOMBOX DLC packs are:

[b]BOOMBOX 1: POP/STARZ[/b] - featuring THE BADDEST and chart-topping hits MORE and POP/STARS, from virtual pop girl group K/DA. This DLC pack also includes the K/DA Ziggs skin.

[b]BOOMBOX 2: ZEGENDS NEVER DIE[/b] - featuring RISE, Phoenix, and Legends Never Die, three incredible tracks that previously premiered during the League of Legends World Championships. This DLC pack also includes the Pro Gamer Ziggs skin.

[b]BOOMBOX 3: GET ZINXED[/b] - featuring Get Jinxed, Warsongs: Piercing Light, and GIANTS by True Damage, the League of Legends supergroup.This DLC pack also includes the True Damage Ziggs skin.

notes.title: Trading Cards Are Here!
notes.content:
Hextech Mayhem Steam Trading Cards have landed! 

If you don't already know, Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and trade-able Steam community items. 

Hextech Mayhem's Community Items Include: 


[list]
[*] Animated Avatars
[*] Avatar Frames
[*] Mini-Profile Backgrounds
[*] Profile Backgrounds
[*] Animated Stickers
[*] Emoticons
[/list]

(Preview:[url=] https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1651960[/url])

Also! No need to worry, Trading Cards will be given to players retroactively for time already played.

What are you still doing on this post? What are you waiting for? Get playing! It is time to collect and trade!

notes.title: Riot Games launches two League of Legends spin-offs, confirms more for next year
notes.content:
Riot Games has launched two of its previously revealed League of Legends spin-offs - Ruined King and Hextech Mayhem - with two new titles now confirmed for release next year.

Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story (as Riot is subtitling all its spin-off games) is a new rhythm runner from Choice Provisions, the studio behind the acclaimed Bit.Trip series.

It sees players, in the role of a yordle named Ziggs, bomb-jumping and bomb-attacking their way across the city of Piltover, with the scientist Heimerdinger in pursuit. Its rhythmic side-scrolling platform action, that unfolds to the beat of the soundtrack, should be immediately familiar to fans of the Bit.Trip runner series.

Read more

notes.title: It’s about to be game over, Piltover!
notes.content:
Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is Riot Forge’s brand new rhythm runner developed by Choice Provisions and it is available to play today!

Hextech Mayhem is set in Piltover, a city in the League of Legends universe. Players will take on the role as Ziggs and bomb, bounce, and bop to the beat of music to avoid obstacles, disarm enemies, and light fuses to achieve maximum chaos. Set out on a chaotic quest to build the greatest bomb the world has ever seen while avoiding no-fun-allowed Heimerdinger!

[previewyoutube=K7pEg82R7P4;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=]
https://hextechmayhem.com/en-us/[/url]

[b]Meet Ziggs: [/b]
With a love of big bombs and short fuses, the yordle Ziggs is an explosive force of nature. As an inventor's assistant in Piltover, he was bored by his predictable life and befriended a mad, blue-haired bomber named Jinx. After a wild night on the town, Ziggs took her advice and moved to Zaun, where he now explores his fascinations more freely, terrorizing the chem-barons and regular citizens alike in his never ending quest to blow stuff up.

[b]Meet Heimerdinger: [/b]
A brilliant yet eccentric yordle scientist, Professor Cecil B. Heimerdinger is one of the most innovative and esteemed inventors Piltover has ever known. Relentless in his work to the point of neurotic obsession, he thrives on answering the universe's most impenetrable questions. Though his theories often appear opaque and esoteric, Heimerdinger has crafted some of Piltover's most miraculous—not to mention lethal—machinery, and constantly tinkers with his inventions to make them even more efficient.

[b]About Piltover:[/b]
Piltover is a thriving, progressive city whose power and influence is on the rise. It is Valoran’s cultural center, where art, craftsmanship, trade and innovation walk hand in hand. Its power comes not through military might, but the engines of commerce and forward thinking. Situated on the cliffs above the district of Zaun and overlooking the ocean, fleets of ships pass through its titanic sea-gates, bringing goods from all over the world. The wealth this generates has given rise to an unprecedented boom in the city’s growth. Piltover has - and still is - reinventing itself as a city where fortunes can be made and dreams can be lived. Burgeoning merchant clans fund development in the most incredible endeavors: grand artistic follies, esoteric hextech research, and architectural monuments to their power. With ever more inventors delving into the emergent lore of hextech, Piltover has become a lodestone for the most skilled craftsmen the world over.

notes.title: Hextech Mayhem FAQ
notes.content:
[b]What type of game is Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends story?[/b]
The game is a rhythm autorunner set in Piltover, featuring Ziggs and Heimerdinger.

[b]Where does this game take place?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is set in Piltover.

[b]How long will Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story be?[/b]
We expect the game to be around 5-6 hours for players that simply want to clear every level. For players reaching for completionist status, however, the limit does not exist.

[b]What platforms will the game be on?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story will be coming to Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam, Epic, and GOG.

[b]Will there be multiplayer? Can I play with my friends?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is a single player rhythm runner and won’t be available with multiplayer.

[b]What regions will the game be available in?[/b]
We are aiming to release the game worldwide.

[b]What champions are in the game?[/b]
Players will be able to play as Ziggs in the game, with Heimerdinger making an appearance in the game as well.

[b]Why is this a Riot Forge game?[/b]
Riot Forge is a publishing label within Riot Games that compliments Riot’s internally developed games. Our focus is to work with experienced studios outside of Riot Games to create bespoke “completable” games set in the League of Legends universe. Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is a new rhythm runner set in the League of Legends universe.

[b]How much will the game cost? Is it Free to Play?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem is priced at $9.99 on Nintendo Switch and PC. Pricing may differ per region.

[b]Will the game be available for Mac OS?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is not available on Mac OS.

[b]Is Hextech Mayhem available to play on Xbox or Playstation?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem: A League of Legends Story is not available on Xbox or Playstation.

[b]Will there be a Thai language version of Hextech Mayhem?[/b]
Yes, there will be a Thai language version of Hextech Mayhem. It is currently delayed but we will announce when we know more soon. 

[b]Is Hextech Mayhem available to play in Swedish?[/b]
Hextech Mayhem is available to play in Swedish only via the Netflix mobile app (coming soon). 

[b]How much storage will Hextech Mayhem take up on my Console[/b]? 
For Switch it will take up 3.3 GB.

[b]What are the difficulty settings in the game?[/b]
The base game has no difficulty settings. There is the option for Players to unlock different versions of each level throughout to provide more of a challenge! 

[b]Is Hextech Mayhem available on mobile devices?[/b] 
Yes, it will be available on all Netflix  (coming soon) Games enabled devices.

[b]What skins are available in Hextech Mayhem?[/b]
The skins available in Hextech Mayhem are: Bombe Artiste Ziggs, Teemo Ziggs, Battleboss Ziggs, Bilgewater Ziggs, Jinx Ziggs, Sugarrush Ziggs, Pool Party Ziggs, Master Arcanist Ziggs, CommanderVideo.

[b]Are Riot Forge games available on the Riot Games Client?[/b]
No, as of right now Riot Forge games are not available via the Riot Games Client, they will be available digitally in platform stores including: Nintendo eShop, Xbox Store, Playstation Network, Steam, Epic, GOG and eventually mobile stores.

[b]Who is Choice Provisions? [/b]
Choice Provisions was founded by Mike Roush and Alex Neuse in 2007 and has since been bringing their unique vibrations to gamers worldwide on as many platforms as possible. Based in Santa Cruz, the team is best known for the BIT.TRIP series of games, including 2018's Runner3 which was released on Nintendo Switch, PS4 and PC.

[b]Why are you working with Choice Provisions?[/b]
The Choice Provisions team is known for their zany and fun music games, and we wanted them to bring their characteristic DNA to the League of Legends universe. Choice has paved the way in the rhythm runner genre, and we knew that mixing Ziggs’ bombastic personality with Choice’s unique talent just made sense. For players looking for a deep dive into lore, Riot Forge has a game for you and for players that just want to take a break and take an explosive run through Piltover, we have something for you too!  

[b]How do we know that these partners will treat the IP correctly?[/b]
One of Riot's strengths is the depth we have created within the League of Legends Universe and the Riot Forge team is here to support our developers and ensure they understand all aspects of the world. Our feedback ensures we create authentic League of Legends games together.

[b]What is it like working with Choice Provisions? [/b]
We have had a lot of fun working with Choice Provisions! We worked very closely with them to ensure our game represents the League of Legends Universe in an imaginative way that we know players of all types will enjoy, whether you are familiar with League of Legends or not! 

[b]What other games have Choice Provisions shipped?[/b]
Choice Provisions' is known for their BIT.TRIP series, and their most recent game releases include The.Bit.Trip, Runner2, and Runner3.
